segments.text: Tony found a silver novel breathing on the shelf
Letters move like little engines riding by themselves
He touched the first electric page, the ceiling became stars
Then fell through rings of prints, it liked two avenues on Mars
A woman in a cobalt coat said choose the eastern door
He laughed and took the western one, the east existed more
Behind him stood another sea who made the other turn
Each decision split the heavens, every answer
One sea wore the captain's crown
One sea watched your city drown
One sea planted gardens on the moon
Parallel seas abound
Every yes makes another world sound
Every no leaves a light underground
Turn one page and the stars spin around Parallels seas abound
But the hand on the choice is mine I can blame every devil I find
Still the consequence follows my line
Traded one small memory for passage through the rain
A childhood window vanished from the houses in his brain
He saved a glass-winged creature from the emperor's machine
Then watched its hungry children strip a satellite clean
he warned a moon of trouble panic shattered half the dome he kept the warning secret no one there
survived till dawn the novel off with footnotes where the guilt could be revised but every
softened sentence put a shadow in his eyes once he built a gate from bone once he ruled the dark
alone once he swore he'd found the key then sold tomorrow for a memory parallel seas abound every
yes makes another world sound every no leaves a lot underground turn one page and the stars spin
around parallel seas abound but the hand on the choice is mine i can blame every devil i find
Still the consequence follows my line
At the final chapter's edge
Still a thousand Tonys there
Some in medals, some in chains
Some dissolving into air
They shouted, picked the perfect path
Erased the worlds that failed
Besaw the lives behind each choice
The beauty and the whale
Then closed the book on paradise
And broke the author's pen
No clean road, no spotless hand
So let them all begin
he returned beside the shelf with silver on his sleeve the room looked almost ordinary if
ordinary could breathe he opened up the curtains three red suns disturbed the blue
a glass wind creature crossed them and he knew the tale was true he could not fold the branches
back or hide what he had done so he wrote beneath the title i am answerable one
parallel seas abound every choice sends the universe out let the captains and the cowards
speak loud i won't vanish in the infinite crowd parallel seas abound all their roads leave a mark
upon mine i will carry the cost and the shine close the book but the ending is mine
The last patient without a sound
And all the seas kept spinning around
Tony faced the three red suns in line
Said every world is yours, this choice is mine
